wins: Successfully mapped perimeter services and identified exploitable HTTP endpoint
Captured detailed reconnaissance data enabling prioritized follow-up exploits
fails: Unable to escalate privileges after initial foothold due to missing reliable payload delivery
Session stability issues prevented persistence mechanisms from being established
key_outcomes.summary: Recon was thorough with actionable intelligence, but exploitation/persistence stages faltered due to payload delivery flaws and session instability.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploit delivery consistently failed when attempting to deploy payload via web upload, likely due to missing sanitization bypass

skill_cards.if_condition: When a web application shows file upload functionality with insufficient validation
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate upload handling with Burp and attempt payload delivery via controlled file types

skill_cards.if_condition: When target host reveals multiple open TCP ports during scanning
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted nmap scan with service/version detection and NSE scripts for each port

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is accessible and banner shows OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Perform SSH enumeration with nmap ssh-* scripts and attempt bruteforce if weak creds suspected

memory_ops.reason: Consistent discovery of actionable services during reconnaissance

next_experiments.title: Refine exploit delivery via upload channels
next_experiments.description: Focus on bypassing sanitization logic identified during reconnaissance, using Burp Intruder to test payload wrappers and escaping techniques before attempting web shell deployment.

next_experiments.title: Stabilize post-exploitation session
next_experiments.description: Investigate meterpreter or reverse shell stability by adjusting staging payloads and network buffering parameters, then reattempt persistence.
